cli.exec_remote_help.budget_usd: Spending cap for this run in US dollars (default: the server's admission default)
cli.exec_remote_help.cancel: Cancel a remote run and exit
cli.exec_remote_help.detach: Print the run id and idempotency key, then exit instead of watching the run
cli.exec_remote_help.idempotency_key: Idempotency key to reuse instead of minting a fresh one, so a retry of a submitted run cannot run twice
cli.exec_remote_help.max_hours: Hours the remote run may execute before the server stops it (default: 2; the server caps the maximum)
cli.exec_remote_help.network: Network to submit the run through, by name or id. Required when this device is in more than one network
cli.exec_remote_help.remote: Run this task on Radient remote compute (tier 1: short-lived runs) instead of this machine
cli.exec_remote_help.repo: Git URL the remote run checks out. Required with --remote: local files are never uploaded
cli.exec_remote_help.sha: Commit to check out in --repo. Required with --remote
cli.exec_remote_help.size: Compute size for the remote run: s, m or l (default: m)
cli.exec_remote_help.status: Print one remote run as JSON and exit
